results.title: Suge Knight Claims Tupac Shakur's Mom Smoked Rapper's Ashes After Late Night Cremation
results.description: Suge Knight claimed he was sent to get Tupac Shakur's body cremated – and then the rapper's mother rolled them into blunts.

results.title: “My moms relationship is so fake": North West’s alleged comments about Lewis Hamilton and Kim Kardashian go viral, but there’s a major problem
results.description: A viral social media post claims North West called Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s relationship “fake” and said Kanye West and Bianca Censori appear more in love. However, there is no credible evidence that North made these remarks during a Twitch stream. The screenshot provides no original recording, transcript or reliable source. The alleged comments therefore remain unverified and should not be treated as fact.

results.title: Seeing double at the Twins Days Festival in Ohio
results.description: The Twins Days Festival bills itself as the largest annual gathering of twins in the world. While the festival celebrates the unique bond between twins, it's also a hub for scientists studying what makes them so alike – and so different. Deema Zein reports from Twinsburg, Ohio.
